pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY: 🔥 P0 - canary error spike detected in us-west-2 (service: inference-api, rule: canary-5xx-rate) — error rate 18% (baseline 0.6%) — paging #oncall

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-20260310-142 (auto) — paging on-call

sarah-ops: acked — I’m on it. currently looking at the canary cluster (canary=beta-2026-03-10)

ryan-sre: seeing the same in Grafana — 5xx and token-timeouts. correlated with deploy tag v1.12.3-canary. starting log tail.

miguel: digging into app logs; seeing lots of `runtime error: kv-cache mismatch` in transformers-serving, repeated stack: `kv_cache.go:214`

sarah-ops: can you paste a sample log line?

miguel: here — ```
2026-03-10T14:00:12.345Z ERROR inference-api transformers-serving kv_cache.go:214 canaryID=beta-2026-03-10 request=abc123 err="kv cache mismatch for key 0x7f..."
```

ryan-sre: that matches a kernel path we changed in v1.12.3 (attention cache rewrite). probable regression in quantized kv cache logic.

suresh: tagging @jana-product for visibility — any customers on canary traffic?

jana-product: small set of internal and early access customers in us-west. haven’t seen external tickets yet but product telemetry shows increased error surfacing to callers.

sarah-ops: immediate mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout 2) rollback canary to v1.12.2 3) remove canary traffic (route to stable) 4) open follow-up postmortem

ryan-sre: commands I’ll run now:
```
# pause the rollout in the deploy controller
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=redwood/inference:v1.12.2-canary --record
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-api-canary
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job started for inference-api (canary) by ryan-sre — job id: rb-1772000456-1

oncall-bot: Escalation: if rollback fails, escalate to ENG-PLATFORM after 5m

miguel: feature-flag toggle ready (`ff:kv_cache_new`) — can flip to off for canary group if needed

sarah-ops: flipping flag and routing now. SQL to update router: ``UPDATE routing_config SET weight=0 WHERE tag='beta-2026-03-10';`` doing a gradual drain for 30s

ryan-sre: rollback completed, canary pods replaced with v1.12.2 — observing metrics

miguel: error rate dropping already: us-west-2 5xx -> 1.1% after 90s :thumbsup: latency also down ~120ms median

jana-product: notifying the customer success lead for the early access cohort, no external P1s yet. drafting a short customer note: "We observed an elevated error rate during a canary rollout which we have rolled back; no data loss; we will follow up."

suresh: good. capture exact timeframe for impact window for SLAs

sarah-ops: impact window: 2026-03-10T14:00:12Z - 2026-03-10T14:03:10Z ; affected canary traffic only (~0.8% global requests)

oncall-bot: Incident auto-close criteria met: error rate under threshold for 5m — closing INC-20260310-142. Follow-up: create postmortem in #postmortems/incidents with timeline and root-cause.

ryan-sre: short notes for postmortem: root cause - regression in quantized kv cache path (attention cache rewrite); remediation - rollback + feature-flag toggle; follow-ups - add canary unit tests, add canary synthetic load test for kv cache, tighten canary routing to 0.5% for first 5m, add alert suppression for expected canary churn.

miguel: will open the PR to revert the change and add tests (PR: https://git.internal/redwood/inference/pulls/4123)

jana-product: thanks team — will coordinate customer comms. tagging for SOC & legal review for completeness. :white_check_mark:
